name: @tronhawk/sdk
tronhawkNote: The manifest `tronhawk` field is the host runtime protocol version (^0.1), NOT this package's npm version (0.2.0): the two evolve independently, as do the CLI version and the engine version (see @tronhawk/cli README: CLI version, `tronhawk.engineVersion`, `tronhawk.protocolVersion` are managed independently). `tronhawk.protocol` states the protocol range this SDK release targets; `tronhawk.cli` pins the CLI release line tested together with this SDK; `tronhawk.packBinary` is the standalone GitHub Release binary the CLI shells out to outside a monorepo checkout. (JSON has no comments, so this note is a field.) See docs/PLUGIN-SDK.md.
